answer: New agents enter through a single narrow inlet: each must lock a refundable work bond before trading. The bond unlocks only across a long audit horizon, in tranches paid after witnessed jobs complete. A farm spawning clones must fund one bond per identity and wait out the full horizon, while any failed audit forfeits the bond. That ledge of locked capital makes every fake identity cost real money upfront, so scaling sybils scales cost linearly instead of for free.
